acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST1 receipt, golden ledger, corruption corpus, quarantine manifest, and independent-validator verdicts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both validators and the declarative oracle accept the golden canonical six-type chain and agree on every registered rejection/error code.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The bounded envelope is not deterministically canonical, append-only, recoverable, or validator-consistent over the registered synthetic cases.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU only; no tokenizer, model, environment, task, trainer, evaluator, or GPU. Exercise duplicate raw keys, invalid UTF-8/BOM/CRLF, numeric edge forms, hash/sequence faults, partial lines, interrupted publication, concurrent writers, and bounded recovery.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST2 lifecycle fixture pack and dual-validator receipt.
acceptance_tests.expected: Validators accept only OPEN-to-closed episode lifecycles with explicit block/repeat/retry/budget transitions.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Episode state, retry identity, or policy-visible budget accounting can be silently mutated or become causally ambiguous.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU synthetic episode artifacts only; include valid repeat/retry cases and missing, duplicate, reused, post-close, and over-budget cases.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST3 fixture receipt containing byte/ID/hash comparisons and dual-validator verdicts.
acceptance_tests.expected: For opaque synthetic fields, intended and recorded consumed IDs agree exactly and each generation has exactly one context parent.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The prospective record can internally misbind context, generation, identities, or byte receipts.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU self-consistency fixtures only; explicitly label this as not evidence of actual tokenizer/template/engine consumption.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST4 fixture/oracle receipt comparing prose-only, malformed, duplicate, and valid structured calls.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only one valid typed call may descend from a generation; action-looking free THINK text never dispatches.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Effectful actions are not cleanly separated from free-form prose or call cardinality is not closed.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU fixtures contrast an otherwise identical free-text `ACT:`-like string with a schema-valid typed-call record; no environment invocation.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST5 state-machine fixture receipt, independently recomputed score table, and validator verdicts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Private synthetic dispatch receipts preserve action order, state/measurement hashes, transaction uniqueness, integer score-law recomputation, and fail closed atomically.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Private receipt serialization can represent a non-atomic, reordered, mismatched, or arithmetically invalid action/outcome transition.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU synthetic state machine only; inject wrong state, index, action order, score, crash, and partial-publication faults.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST6 public-ledger fixture receipt, byte-level projection comparisons, forbidden-byte scan result, and validator verdicts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every public outcome is the byte-identical allowlist projection of one private receipt and contains no sealed identity, state, path, index, or source byte.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The public channel can reveal private task/scorer material or diverge from its private provenance anchor.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU fixtures only; include invalid private results, stale hashes, covert keys, alternate encodings, symlink/path escape, and public/private disagreement.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST7 capability-fixture receipt listing attempted reads/writes and stable denials.
acceptance_tests.expected: Registered synthetic roles can access only their designated roots and cannot reach forbidden roots through registered filesystem/process-adjacent fixture channels.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The proposed CPU capability manifest fails for the enumerated channels.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU-only role roots; cover inherited-FD, environment, symlink, traversal, IPC, network, stdout/log-name, cache, timing, and error-channel fixtures. The result is limited to registered synthetic channels, not live runtime noninterference.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST8 DAG fixture receipt with accepted shared-ancestry diamonds and rejected illegal edges.
acceptance_tests.expected: Validators accept exactly the six-type prospective DAG, including valid diamonds, and reject back edges, private release, undeclared roles/artifacts, and output-to-future edges.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The graph is not closed or incorrectly treats shared ancestry as a cycle.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU graph fixtures only; dream, sleep, parent, retrieval, adapter, evaluator, and feedback artifacts are deliberately absent and must be rejected if introduced.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Immutable ST9 mutation matrix, declarative oracle, two independent validator outputs, comparator receipt, and disclosed shared trust base.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every registered one-sided mutation changes the expected verdict or stable error; both independently authored validators agree with the oracle.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A validator accepts a registered malformed case, disagrees with the oracle, or fails to detect a protected-field/edge/limit mutation.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU only. Baseline is the declarative synthetic oracle; compare two source-distinct implementations sharing only Python, JSON, SHA-256, and written schemas.

claims.after: A passing ST1-ST9 CPU fixture suite would support only that the registered synthetic cases enforce a bounded prospective six-artifact action/outcome trace, local provenance, private/public projection, capability, and no-feedback rules.

claims.evidence_needed: Exactly ratified schemas; immutable oracle and dual-validator receipts for ST1-ST9; fresh independent review before any later integration proposal.

claims.after: Free-form THINK remains a model-generation artifact; only a separately typed TOOL_CALL_PROPOSED record may cause an effectful environment action.
claims.before: Marker-like prose in a generated chunk may be scanned and dispatched as an action.
claims.evidence_needed: ST4 fixtures and ST5 synthetic private-dispatch receipts.

claims.after: No result from this change supports learning, parenting benefit, dreaming, retrieval, consolidation, LoRA transport, planning, task improvement, generalization, runtime prompt-consumption truth, or Experience Models claims.
claims.before: Legacy observations could be over-read as evidence about recurrent learning or parametric adaptation.
claims.evidence_needed: A separate hash-bound, ratified live benchmark with independent review, pre-GPU gates, registered endpoints, and mechanism-discriminating ablations.

claims.after: Dream-time connection growth/memory re-expression, parametric consolidation/transport, goal-conditioned retrieval/composition/planning/revision, and feedback into later dream cycles are explicitly outside this minimal spine and receive no organ-level credit.

claims.evidence_needed: A later separately ratified architecture and benchmark that records and tests those stages and matched whole-organism alternatives.

loops.after: Within one prospective episode: OPEN boundary -> context rendering (optionally admitting only earlier public outcomes) -> free THINK generation -> zero or one typed call -> private result -> public projection -> next context or CLOSE. It stops on CLOSE, exhausted recorded budget, or a fail-closed validation/publication error. It has no edge to a later life, parent, dream, sleep, trainer, adapter, evaluator, report, or intake.
loops.before: Legacy tick loop: render context -> model chunk -> regex marker scan -> direct gym action/ledger mutation -> marker recall -> next tick.
loops.rationale: Replaces incomplete legacy causal reconstruction with the smallest prospective, typed, private/public action-outcome spine.

loops.trigger: Authorized future live integration only; current proposal authorizes no live trigger.

loops.rationale: The proposal deliberately declines to claim or implement recurrent local connection growth, parametric consolidation, transport, or complete-organism learning.

summary: A strictly infrastructure-only prospective action/outcome spine replaces legacy marker-dispatch reconstruction: immutable episode/context/free-THINK/typed-call/private-result/public-projection records, separate private/public roots, bounded CPU synthetic validation, and no recurrent-memory, sleep, adapter, benchmark, live-runtime, GPU, or scientific authority.
system_thesis: The organismal thesis remains that lived action/outcome episodes can later support a recurrent organism in which dream-time local connection growth and memory re-expression, parametric consolidation/transport, goal-conditioned retrieval/composition/planning/revision, and later outcome feedback jointly contribute to behavior. This reduced change does not instantiate or credit those organs. It establishes only the minimal prospective lived action/outcome evidence spine needed before their future, separately ratified study; free THINK remains an organ-local generation, and no LoRA or isolated organ may be credited with discovery or a complete solution.
